description: Who are the great pool, snooker and carom players, and what is each one known for? 45 players, each with the method they are known for. Filter by part of a name (q), by country as commonly listed, or by ONE lower-case game tag; combine them, or send nothing for all 45. The game tag has exactly one spelling each: eight-ball, nine-ball, ten-ball, rotation, one-pocket, straight pool, snooker, three-cushion carom, money games - '9-ball' and 'Nine-ball' will miss. The order is editorial and is NOT a ranking; do not present a position as a standing.

game.description: One lower-case tag from the list.

q.description: Part of a name. Example: Reyes
